context_for_next_testing_agent: Sync-All-Collections feature is fully implemented and working. Key endpoints: GET /api/data-management/sync/status (returns 68+ collections dynamically), GET /api/data-management/export-all (exports ALL collections), POST /api/data-management/import-all (bulk import), POST /api/data-management/sync/from-deployed (pulls from production), POST /api/data-management/sync/attendance (attendance-only sync).
